data.one_liner: Customizable Flutter calendar widget with range picking and event showing.
data.what_it_does: Provides a horizontally scrollable month view calendar with event lines over days and a date selection dialog mode. It allows customization of day cells, week days, headers, and selection touch modes.
use_when: You need a Google Calendar-inspired UI in your Flutter application.
You require customizable calendar event rendering over day cells.
You need a date range picker dialog with customizable buttons and layout.
avoid_when: You need a non-calendar scheduling tool or a simple list-based agenda without a month grid.
Frequent setState calls on the parent page cannot be avoided, which may cause performance issues.
strengths: Supports event lines displayed directly over day cells
Includes a built-in date range picker dialog
Highly customizable builders for days, week days, and buttons
weaknesses: Frequent setState calls on the page using the calendar can impact performance
Limited documentation outside of README parameter tables
